decision_rationale: BASIC QUALIFICATION: All four gates passed (revenue USD 3.02m > USD 1m; UK approved; 7 years tenure; imports physical goods).
DEEP QUALIFICATION: Critical failures on cash runway (0.59 months vs 6-month threshold) and ADB sufficiency (unable to verify, severe decline evident).

HIGH-SEVERITY RED FLAGS: Three high-severity flags identified: (1) Undisclosed ┬ú52,000 director's loan on 2026-02-14 representing potential cash extraction; (2) Severe 92% liquidity decline from ┬ú231k to ┬ú18k in one month; (3) Cash runway of only 18 days indicating imminent insolvency risk.

METHOD A LIQUIDITY: Cannot reliably calculate due to ADB data gap and severe end-period decline. Proxy ADB of ┬ú178k from transaction EOD balances is invalidated by the ┬ú52k director withdrawal and subsequent collapse to ┬ú18k.
METHOD B REVENUE: While revenue caps would theoretically allow up to ┬ú480k combined limit (┬ú240k IF + ┬ú240k Inventory), this is irrelevant given liquidity failure.
REPAYMENT FIT: FAIL. Weekly debit of ┬ú9,375 (based on ┬ú150k request / 16 weeks) is 52% of current min balance (┬ú18,100) and would likely trigger immediate default.
RECOMMENDED LIMIT: ┬ú0. Customer does not meet minimum liquidity standards and shows signs of financial distress.

DECISION RATIONALE: The combination of (a) undisclosed material related-party transaction, (b) catastrophic liquidity decline not explained by normal operations, (c) cash runway below 1 month, and (d) inability to calculate reliable ADB makes this an unacceptable credit risk. The business may be experiencing severe financial distress or mismanagement. Additional OceanX capital would be at immediate risk of loss.
